title: Freeze Stage 0 decisions with complete coverage and owner-stop prerequisites
description: As an evaluator, I need a reproducible text-free Stage0 decision artifact bound to policy, dataset/split, SME identity and complete S/F/agreement results, so incomplete collections cannot pass and Stage1 cannot start before the owner looks. Scenario: full300 heldout predictions for both S/F and full100 paired SME agreement are required; F macroF1>=.80 and S<=F-.10; agreement>=.85; malformed/missing cells refuse a pass; synthetic output never authorizes live collection. Record merge-once/stop/fail/incomplete status explicitly, hash immutable evidence and record actual usage without invented pricing. Stage1 prerequisites require a successful non-synthetic screen plus explicit content-bound owner approval. Build/spec pure gate and safe cached-data orchestration seams; no model/download calls or mutating original caches. DoD: fake complete/incomplete fixtures, deterministic hashes, strict identity/cap/owner gates, text-free output, no DSPy.
